name: Big Deck
requirement: Win with at least 40 cards in the final deck for Bronze, 60 for Silver, or 100 for Gold.

name: C-C-C-Combo
requirement: Play at least 20 cards in one turn.

name: Curses
requirement: Win with at least 5 Curse cards in the final deck.

name: Damage Leader
requirement: In co-op, have the most recorded damage dealt after at least 5 map points in the first act. Ties go to the first player in run order.

name: Debuffer
requirement: In co-op, have the most recorded debuffs applied after at least 5 map points in the first act. Ties go to the first player in run order.

name: Double Snecko
requirement: Finish with both Snecko Eye and Fake Snecko Eye.

name: Elite Killer
requirement: Defeat at least 3 elites for Bronze, 6 for Silver, or 9 for Gold.

name: Famished
requirement: Win with maximum HP below half the character's normal starting HP.

name: Glutton
requirement: Win with maximum HP at least 15 above the character's normal starting HP for Bronze, 30 for Silver, or 50 for Gold.

name: Healer
requirement: In co-op, use Mend at rest sites at least once for Bronze, twice for Silver, or 3 times for Gold.

name: Highlander
requirement: Win with no duplicate non-Basic card IDs in the final deck. Basic cards are ignored.

name: Honed
requirement: Win with at least 5 copies of one non-Basic card ID in the final deck. Upgrade levels do not separate copies.

name: I Like Shiny
requirement: Finish with at least 25 relics.

name: Ka-Ching
requirement: Spend at least 1,000 Gold in shops during the run.

name: Money Money
requirement: Win holding at least 200 Gold for Bronze, 400 for Silver, or 600 for Gold.

name: Mystery Machine
requirement: Visit at least 15 unknown map points during the run, regardless of the rooms revealed.

name: Perfect
requirement: Defeat a boss without taking damage in that fight for Bronze; 2 such boss fights earn Silver, 3 earn Gold. A fatal final boss fight is excluded.

name: Restful
requirement: Win after visiting at least one rest site and choosing Rest at every rest site visited.

name: Restless
requirement: Win after visiting at least one rest site without ever choosing Rest.

name: Speedy
requirement: Win in at most 50 minutes for Bronze, 40 for Silver, or 30 for Gold, using the game's recorded win time.

name: Tablet
requirement: Win with exactly 1 maximum HP.

name: Team Player
requirement: In co-op, finish with at least 3 multiplayer-only cards in the final deck.

name: Tiny Deck
requirement: Win with at most 20 cards in the final deck for Bronze, 10 for Silver, or 5 for Gold.
